visual.general_description: Six clinical photographs of palms and soles in two rows: baseline (A to C) and apremilast at 5 weeks (D to F).

The top row, labelled "Baseline", shows both palms (A) and two soles (B, C) with pink-red scaly skin and scattered pale yellowish and brown flecks. The bottom row, labelled "Apremilast (5 weeks)", shows both palms (D) and two soles (E, F) with lighter pink skin and a smaller area of residual redness and scale.
